_comment: 来源：mod 仓库 _docs/data/units/枪骑马武士兵种设计.md；desc / story 取 loc unit_description_short_texts / unit_description_historical_texts（中英原文）；建筑名照 loc 官方英文。

desc.zh: 披挂大铠、手持长枪的精锐骑马武士。其疾如风，侵掠如火。
desc.en: Samurai cavalry in great armour, riding down the foe with levelled yari. Swift as the wind, fierce as fire.

story.zh: 尼朋列岛山势险阻、平野逼仄，适宜放牧繁育良种战马的草场极为罕见。因此，唯有战功卓著的骁勇武士，或是世受大名厚禄的知名武家子弟，才能被遴选编入“骑马众”。两军交战之际，他们游弋于大阵两翼寻觅战机；待敌方步线因交战推挤露出破绽之时，整队重骑便如狂飙席卷而出。
story.en: The isles of Nippon are a land of jagged mountains and narrow plains, where pasture fit for breeding warhorses is all but unknown. Only warriors of proven valour, or sons of famed houses raised on a daimyo's stipend, are ever chosen for the mounted bands. In battle they prowl the flanks of the host, watching for the moment when the enemy line buckles beneath the press of combat - and then the whole band of heavy horse breaks upon it like a storm.

v.zh: 侍大将屋形（舰上武者屋形链 3 级）／旗本番（岸上侍所链 3 级）
v.en: Samurai Taisho's Manor (fleetboard warrior-manor chain, tier 3) / Hatamoto Guard (shore Samurai Hall chain, tier 3)

k.zh: 近战武器威力（基础／破甲）

desc.zh: 护甲 90 的重装大铠，可抵御除高破甲武器外的多数伤害；无盾牌防御远程直射
desc.en: Armour 90 turns aside all but the most armour-piercing blows; no shield against direct missile fire

desc.zh: 强悍的长枪冲击力，擅长突破、冲散并消灭成建制的敌方步兵阵线
desc.en: A fearsome charge that breaks and rides down formed infantry lines

cth_npex_unit_passive_bushido.zh: 生命值降至 50% 或以下时自动激活：基础／破甲武器杀伤 +15%、近战攻击 +10、永不败逃，持续 25 秒
cth_npex_unit_passive_bushido.en: Triggers at 50% health or below: base and armour-piercing weapon damage +15%, melee attack +10 and Unbreakable, for 25 seconds
